title: I2RT YAM pick-and-place in Isaac Sim
description: Actual simulator RGB recording: grasp, lift, transfer, release onto plate, and withdraw.
robot_model: I2RT YAM standard v1 with linear gripper and D405 wrist assembly
controller: Scripted Cartesian waypoints, numerical URDF inverse kinematics, joint position drives. No trained policy.
limitations: Simulation only; no physical robot connection.
One nominal success, not a robustness evaluation.
Estimated contact friction and uncalibrated actuator dynamics.
